short_description: Guide a loaf from mixing through folds to proofing using the times you actually start each step.
description: Guide a loaf from mixing through folds to proofing using the times you actually start each step. Click to mark a completed stage and start the next timer from now. Turn the wheel to adjust the duration of the active stage in five-minute increments. Late folds naturally shift the rest of the recipe. Start previews total remaining time. Hold Start opens a fresh loaf.
changelog: New screen transitions and high-contrast LED previews.
